1: // Minimal Neon Escape game based on IDEA.md
2: (function(){
3:   const canvas=document.getElementById('game');
4:   if(!canvas){console.error('Canvas #game not found');return;}
5:   const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const resize=()=>{canvas.width=window.innerWidth;canvas.height=window.innerHeight;colW=canvas.width/COLS;};
7:   window.addEventListener('resize',resize);
8:   resize();
9:   const COLS=7, ROW_H=30, ORB_R=12;
10:   let colW, speed=2, tick=0, gameOver=false;
11:   let orbCol=Math.floor(COLS/2);
12:   const obstacles=[]; // {y, cells:[{floor, spike}]}
13:   function spawnRow(){
14:     const cells=[];
15:     for(let i=0;i<COLS;i++){
16:       const floor=Math.random()>0.2; // 80% floor
17:       const spike=floor && Math.random()<0.1; // 10% of floors are spikes
18:       cells.push({floor, spike});
19:     }
20:     obstacles.push({y:-ROW_H, cells});
21:   }
22:   function update(){
23:     if(gameOver) return;
24:     tick+=speed;
25:     // move obstacles
26:     for(const o of obstacles) o.y+=speed;
27:     // remove offscreen
28:     while(obstacles.length && obstacles[0].y>canvas.height) obstacles.shift();
29:     // spawn new row at interval
30:     if(tick%ROW_H===0) spawnRow();
31:     // collision check when obstacle reaches orb line
32:     for(const o of obstacles){
33:       if(o.y+ROW_H>canvas.height-ROW_H && o.y<canvas.height-ROW_H){
34:         const cell=o.cells[orbCol];
35:         if(!cell.floor||cell.spike){gameOver=true;}
36:       }
37:     }
38:     draw();
39:     if(!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(update);
40:     else drawGameOver();
41:   }
42:   function draw(){
43:     ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
44:     // draw grid
45:     ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(0,255,255,0.2)';
46:     for(let i=0;i<=COLS;i++){
47:       ctx.beginPath();
48:       ctx.moveTo(i*colW,0);
49:       ctx.lineTo(i*colW,canvas.height);
50:       ctx.stroke();
51:     }
52:     for(let y=0;y<canvas.height;y+=ROW_H){
53:       ctx.beginPath();
54:       ctx.moveTo(0,y);
55:       ctx.lineTo(canvas.width,y);
56:       ctx.stroke();
57:     }
58:     // draw obstacles
59:     for(const o of obstacles){
60:       for(let i=0;i<COLS;i++){
61:         const cell=o.cells[i];
62:         if(cell.floor){
63:           ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
64:           ctx.fillRect(i*colW,o.y,colW,ROW_H);
65:           if(cell.spike){
66:             ctx.fillStyle='lime';
67:             ctx.beginPath();
68:             ctx.moveTo(i*colW+colW/2, o.y+ROW_H/2-8);
69:             ctx.lineTo(i*colW+colW/2-8, o.y+ROW_H/2+8);
70:             ctx.lineTo(i*colW+colW/2+8, o.y+ROW_H/2+8);
71:             ctx.closePath();
72:             ctx.fill();
73:           }
74:         }
75:       }
76:     }
77:     // draw orb
78:     ctx.fillStyle='cyan';
79:     ctx.beginPath();
80:     ctx.arc(orbCol*colW+colW/2, canvas.height-ROW_H/2, ORB_R,0,2*Math.PI);
81:     ctx.fill();
82:   }
83:   function drawGameOver(){
84:     ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
85:     ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
86:     ctx.fillStyle='white';
87:     ctx.font='48px sans-serif';
88:     ctx.textAlign='center';
89:     ctx.fillText('Game Over',canvas.width/2,canvas.height/2);
90:   }
91:   canvas.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(gameOver) return; const half=canvas.width/2; if(e.clientX<half) orbCol=Math.max(0,orbCol-1); else orbCol=Math.min(COLS-1,orbCol+1);});
92:   spawnRow();
93:   requestAnimationFrame(update);
94: })();
